compositions.title: Two companions choose a dwelling
compositions.text: Twēgen gefēran ridon wīde. Hīe fundon twā hofu. Ān hof wæs micel, and ān hof wæs lȳtel. Hīe curon ðæt lȳtle hof. Hīe hæfdon męte and wæter. Hīe druncon ðæt wæter and geręston hīe on ðǣm lȳtlan hofe. Ān mann sægde: “Wit habbað gōd hof. Ic singe, and ðū hīerst mē.”
compositions.orientation: The two companions are the two men of the account. The final quotation is spoken by one to the other.
compositions.scope: No supplied forms or senses may remain in the final controlled account. The inherited locative on phrase locates their resting, not a direction of travel.
